PHOTO TILE (Lantern 1.24.42, after the mends of the first review) -- A FOURTH, INDEPENDENT REVIEW
==============================================================================================
Reviewer: a separate agent that did not write the tile or the mends. Date: 2026-11-26.
Build tested: the frozen single file scratchpad/photo_r3/index.html (6,740,993 bytes), served over http, opened at
#photo in Chromium (Playwright, headless), 1400 x 900 unless said; also 1366 x 768, 1920 x 1080 and 390 x 844.
Driven as a person drives it: the menu bar, the tool column, the options bar, the Layers/History/Swatches panels,
keys, drags and pointer moves on the picture, dropped files (DragEvent with a DataTransfer holding a File).
The document's state (Lantern.photo.api.d, compose.all/render) is only READ, to check results. One spy is used:
the drop check counts calls of Lantern.photo.api.openDoc (it changes nothing).

Files here
  run_review.py    every check: python3 run_review.py [path/to/index.html] [section ...]
                   sections: groups groups2 boxes newboxes styles keys maglasso swatches drop typetool transform
                   image mends sizes big. Prints PASS/FAIL per check and "N checks, M failed". ~4.5 minutes.
  harness.py       the server, Chromium, and a person's actions (begun from photo_review2_1242/harness.py and
                   extended: Layers rows by exact name, group triangles, renaming, drops, Place, sliders by label).
  make_inputs.py   makes inputs/ (deterministic): a landscape, a dark-red blob on a busy striped noisy background
                   (and its true mask), a flat grey picture, a dark square on white, a 5-degree horizon, a badge and
                   an oversize picture to drop, colour bars, a backlit figure, warm/cool/orange-cast photos, a
                   picture whose pixels encode their own x and y, a .psd with a group made by psd-tools. 832 KB.
                   The 12-megapixel photo is made at run time.
  cases.json       the full run on the frozen build, as found: 289 checks, 48 failed (every check, with what was
                   seen, passes too). A run on any other build writes cases_last_run.json instead, so this record
                   is not overwritten.
  evidence/        laptop_1366x768.png (the tool column), phone_tools.png.

HOW SURE: "certain" = reproduced in the browser and traced to the code; "high" = reproduced, and Photoshop's
behaviour is documented or well known; "medium" = reproduced, but Photoshop's exact behaviour is from memory.
Photoshop itself was not run.

The full run was repeated: three runs of the final script gave the same 48 failures (see the end).

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FAILURES, MOST IMPORTANT FIRST
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. A box is still not modal for the menu bar, the History panel and the Layers panel -- and one path loses an
   earlier step for good. (The first review's finding 3 is mended only for the picture and the keys.)
   With a box open (Image > Adjustments > Hue/Saturation, Hue +120 previewed on a copy layer):
   a) Edit > Undo from the menu runs: a History step is undone under the open box.
   b) Image > Adjustments > Levels... opens over it. The Hue/Saturation box is replaced without its Cancel, and
      OK in Levels then drops the Hue/Saturation that was showing on the picture (no step for it).
   c) File > Save writes a .psd: it holds the unconfirmed preview (pixel 50,50 = 228,73,131; as opened 95,151,226).
   d) A click on a History step goes back (to "Open") behind the box.
   e) A click on the Background's row in the Layers panel, then OK: the Hue/Saturation lands on the Background,
      not on the copy it was previewed on (the copy is unchanged). What was previewed is not what is done.
   f) The Layers panel's "Adjust..." list while the box is open:
      - with a picture layer chosen: an uncaught error "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'p')";
      - with an adjustment layer chosen (an Invert layer): a second box opens that previews the Invert layer as a
        Threshold; Cancel in both boxes then DELETES THE INVERT LAYER (it undoes the person's last step) and
        empties Redo, so Ctrl+Shift+Z cannot bring it back. Steps: open a photo; Adjust... > Invert; click the
        Background; Image > Adjustments > Hue/Saturation; click the Invert layer's row; Adjust... > Threshold;
        Cancel; Cancel. History is back to "Open" and the Invert layer is gone.
   g) (smaller) After a click outside the box (on the picture, a tool, a panel), Enter no longer OKs it: the
      box's own keydown listener only hears keys while the focus is inside it.
   Traced: api.boxOpen() is checked only in api.exec, the keys and drops (PHOTO_TILE). The menu items that run
   directly (Edit > Undo/Redo call D.undo/D.redo; every item that opens a box through P.dialog, which empties
   the dialog host; File > Save/Export/Print), the History rows (D.goTo, D.redo) and the Layers rows (d.active =
   i) do not ask. PHOTO_ADJ_UI open(): when exec("newAdjustment") is refused it still sets layerIndex = d.active
   and made = d.hist.length, so its Cancel ("fresh && d.hist.length === made") undoes and pops the last real step.
   Should: Photoshop's adjustment and filter dialogs are modal: nothing else in the window can be used until OK
   or Cancel, and Enter is OK, Esc is Cancel, wherever the pointer was clicked. Sure: certain (behaviour), high
   (Photoshop).

2. With a group anywhere in the picture, the picture cannot be turned, flipped or straightened.
   Steps: put any layer in a group (Ctrl+G); Image > Image Rotation > 90 deg Clockwise (or Flip Canvas
   Horizontal, or Straighten by the Ruler line after drawing a Ruler line).
   What happens: nothing changes; the line under the picture says '"Group 1" is a group: choose a layer in it
   (or Layer > Merge Group)', whichever layer is chosen. A .psd from Photoshop with groups (most have them)
   therefore cannot be rotated or straightened at all.
   Traced: PHOTO_OPS_IMAGE rotate, flip, crop with an angle and perspectiveCrop call O.rasterize on every layer
   whose kind is not pixel or adjust; rasterize throws for a group. (Crop with a turn and Perspective Crop were not
   run with a group; they have the same line.) Image Size and Canvas Size do work with groups.
   Should: these change every layer and leave groups as groups. Sure: certain.

3. Free Transform leaks into the rest of the tile (five ways).
   a) While Free Transform is on, the layer is hidden for the preview (previewHidden). Any command run meanwhile
      by its key records that mark in History. Ctrl+T, Ctrl+I (it runs), Esc, Ctrl+I, Ctrl+Z: the layer is
      INVISIBLE although its eye is on, and stays so whenever History comes back to that state.
      Ctrl+T, Ctrl+J (Layer via Copy), Esc: the copy never shows.
   b) Ctrl+T, then File > Quick Export as PNG: the exported PNG has no such layer in it (it was hidden).
   c) Ctrl+T on a red layer, drag it 100 px, click the Background's row in the Layers panel, Enter: the
      BACKGROUND is moved 100 px (an empty strip is left at its left edge); the red layer stays where it was.
   d) Ctrl+T, drag the layer 100 px to the right, type Angle 10 on the options bar, Enter: the layer is turned
      back where it started (centre x 150, not 250): typing a number rebuilds the box from the start (optChange)
      and throws the drag away.
   e) Ctrl+T on a group: the box can be dragged, then Enter says '"Group 1" is a group: choose a layer in it' and
      nothing happens. Photoshop transforms every layer of the group.
   Traced: PHOTO_TRANSFORM_UI marks the live layer (l.previewHidden); D.snap copies every field of a layer;
   commit() transforms D.active(d), whatever is chosen at Enter; Edit > Free Transform and the keys are not
   blocked while it runs. Should: Photoshop greys out most menu commands during Free Transform and keeps the
   transform on the layer it began on; its W/H/Angle boxes act from where the box is now. Sure: certain
   (behaviour), high (Photoshop, from memory).

4. Ctrl+Z pressed while the mouse button is still held in a brush stroke loses two strokes.
   Steps: paint a stroke (one "Brush" step); start a second stroke, and before letting go press Ctrl+Z; let go.
   What happens: the FIRST stroke is undone, the second (being drawn) is lost too, an empty "Brush" step is
   recorded, and Redo is emptied: neither stroke can be brought back.
   Traced: PHOTO_TILE's keydown runs P.shortcut before its "a stroke is under way" test (S.d.open), so Undo runs
   in the middle of D.begin ... D.end. (Other Ctrl keys pressed mid-stroke are likely the same; not tried.)
   Should: no command while the button is held (Photoshop takes none then: from memory, medium-high). The first
   review's mend for tool letters (6b) holds: M pressed mid-stroke keeps the stroke.

5. With a group chosen, nine tools throw an error instead of saying no; six of them leave the tool keys dead.
   Patch, Red Eye, Dodge, Burn, Sponge, Blur, Sharpen, Smudge and Paint Bucket, used on the picture with a group
   chosen: nothing changes (right), but each throws an uncaught error and shows no message of its own (the line
   under the picture keeps whatever it said before). Dodge, Burn, Sponge, Blur, Sharpen and Smudge also leave
   the document "in a stroke" (D.begin with no end): after them, the tool letters do nothing (B does not pick the
   Brush) until a stroke with another tool is finished. Brush, Pencil, Eraser, Clone Stamp, History Brush, Spot
   Healing, Healing Brush and Gradient refuse plainly, as do the filters, adjustments, Shadows/Highlights and
   Alt+Backspace. Traced: PHOTO_TOOLS_RETOUCH's dab tools call D.begin, then O.rasterize, which throws for a
   group; the Patch, Red Eye and Bucket call pixelOp outside a try. Sure: certain.

6. Merge Visible throws away hidden layers that sit inside a visible group.
   Steps: a group with a visible layer and a hidden one; Layer > Merge Visible (Ctrl+Shift+E).
   What happens: the picture is right, but the hidden layer is gone (only one layer is left). Without groups,
   Merge Visible keeps hidden layers. Ctrl+Z brings it back. Traced: PHOTO_GROUPS mergeVisible keeps only hidden
   top-level units. Should: Photoshop's Merge Visible leaves hidden layers alone (Adobe community answer:
   it "will ignore any layer that has its visibility toggled off"). Sure: certain / high.

7. Redo does not choose again the layer it brings back -- the mend for "Undo keeps the chosen layer" goes too far.
   Steps: Layer > New Layer, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z: the Background is chosen, not the new layer; the next stroke
   goes on the Background. Worse: Duplicate Layer on a group, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z, then the Delete button:
   the FIRST group is deleted, not its copy (seen in this review's own run).
   Traced: PHOTO_DOC keepChosen keeps the layer chosen before Redo whenever it still exists. Should: Redo returns
   the state as it was after the step, the layer that step chose included (Photoshop's History: medium, from
   memory). Undo keeping the chosen layer (the first review's finding 8) holds and is right.

8. The tool column: every tool button is 40 x 40 in a 30 or 34 px cell, so the buttons overlap and the right-hand
   column is cut in half at every desktop size.
   Measured: 1366 x 768 and 1400 x 900 -- three 30 px columns, 24 overlapping pairs, 12 buttons cut at the
   column's right edge (Eraser, Rectangular Marquee, Polygonal Lasso, Move, Hand, Spot Healing, Red Eye, Sponge,
   Smudge, Crop, Shape, Quick Mask); 1920 x 1080 -- two 34 px columns, 18 overlaps, 18 cut; phone -- 32 overlaps.
   At 1366 x 768 the last row (Swap, Default colours, Quick Mask) is also below the column's visible bottom
   (600 px of column, 627 px of content: reachable only by scrolling the column).
   evidence/laptop_1366x768.png shows the cut icons; evidence/phone_tools.png the overlaps.
   Traced: Lantern's own stylesheet, line 408 of the build: button{min-height:40px;min-width:40px} wins over the
   tile's .ph-tool{width:34px;height:34px} (and the 30 px of its max-height:900px rule). Sure: certain.

9. Type: words aligned centre or right cannot be clicked to edit them.
   Steps: Type tool, alignment "center" (or "right") on the options bar, click and type "Wide words", choose
   Move; Type tool, click on the words' own letters (their left part).
   What happens: a new, empty type box opens (a second type layer if anything is typed). Traced: PHOTO_TOOLS_MAKE
   Type down() tests x from text.x to text.x + width, as if every line were left-aligned; centred words run
   from x - w/2, right-aligned ones end at x. Left-aligned words (also after a move) do open. Sure: certain.

10. Straighten by the Ruler line uses a line drawn on a different picture.
    Steps: draw a Ruler line on one picture; open another; Image > Image Rotation > Straighten by the Ruler line.
    What happens: the new picture is turned and cropped (640 -> 575 wide) by the old picture's line, with no
    word. Traced: api.lastRuler is kept for the tile, not the picture. Should: ask for a line (as it does when
    none was drawn). Sure: certain.

11. Smaller.
    a) Undo shuts a group the person opened: the triangle's open/shut state is kept in each History state, so
       Ctrl+Z (or Undo past the point where it was shut) shuts it again. Opening is not a step, so Undo should not
       change it. Medium (Photoshop, memory).
    b) A picture dropped on the start screen's dashed box is opened twice (the box's own drop listener and the
       tile-wide one both open it): harmless for a small file, twice the wait for a big .psd. Certain.
    c) B with the Pencil in use goes back to the Brush. Photoshop's key picks the tool now showing in its group
       (the Pencil); only Shift+B moves along. The help describes the tile's way, so a difference, not a broken
       promise. Medium (memory).
    d) The help says clicking words "shows their own font, size and colour on the options bar": the font and
       size are shown; the options bar has no colour and the foreground colour box keeps the old colour (the
       typing box does draw the words in their own colour). Low.
    e) Image > Adjustments still lists "Invert..." though it opens no box (first review's 32). Trivial.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WHAT WORKED (PASS in cases.json, briefly)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Groups: Ctrl+G (picture unchanged, one step), Layer > New Group (beside a chosen group, inside a group when a
  layer in it is chosen), Ctrl+Shift+G, the triangle (not a step), up/down into an open group, past a shut one,
  out at the top and bottom; New Layer above a shut group stays outside it; nesting (P in Group 2 in Group 3,
  set in twice as far); duplicate (the copy's layers belong to the copied groups) and delete of a group; Merge
  Group by Ctrl+E (the menu then says "Merge Group"), keeping the look at 50% group opacity, staying inside its
  parent group in its own mode; pass through only for groups; Pass Through vs Normal with an Invert adjustment
  layer inside (as the help says); Move tool on a group; a mask on a group; Brush, filters, adjustments and
  fills refused plainly with a group chosen. Undo and Redo give back the exact layers and picture through each of
  12 group commands tried one by one. Saved .psd: psd-tools reads the groups, nesting, 60% opacity, Multiply, a hidden
  group and the same picture (within 3 levels); opened again the tile has the same layers and picture. A .psd
  with a group made by psd-tools opens as a group with its hidden layer hidden.
- Boxes: a click on the picture paints nothing and says to finish the box; Ctrl+I, Ctrl+Z, Select > All refused;
  Esc and Cancel leave every layer exactly as before; Enter in a box's number field OKs; the Layers panel's
  Adjust... and Layer > New Adjustment Layer then Cancel or Esc leave nothing (no layer, no step, no Redo).
  Shadows/Highlights lifts a dark figure (+15 levels or more) with the sky within 6, Highlights darkens the sky,
  OK equals the preview, not offered as an adjustment layer; Match Color from another layer moves the mean colour
  most of the way, Neutralize reduces an orange cast; Replace Color turns the red bar and leaves the others within
  3; Selective Color starts Relative, takes red from reds only, Absolute more than Relative, Cancel leaves
  nothing. Layer Style: Inner Glow, Bevel & Emboss (lit top-left, shaded bottom-right), Satin, Pattern Overlay
  after Edit > Define Pattern (repeated from the picture's corner); Cancel leaves no style; OK is one step.
- Keys: after ticking Lock, moving a slider, choosing from a list, or Enter in an options-bar number box, the
  tool keys, [ ] and Ctrl+Z work; B stays on Brush, Shift+B goes to Pencil; a tool letter mid-stroke keeps the
  stroke; Delete and Backspace with nothing selected do nothing and say so; Alt+Backspace / Ctrl+Backspace fill
  with the foreground / background colour; Ctrl+Shift+Alt+W opens Export As; Esc closes a menu (with its
  submenu open); Esc mid-marquee drops it; Polygonal Lasso Backspace, Esc, Enter; renaming by double-click.
- Magnetic Lasso: L, Shift+L, Shift+L reaches it; round a square 3 px off its edge, overlap 0.999; 8 px off,
  still on the edge; round a blob on a busy striped noisy background with a 4 px unsteady hand, overlap 0.997;
  Esc, Backspace to nothing, Backspace twice, double-click, a click on the first point, the pointer leaving the
  picture and coming back, Shift at the first click adds; a flat picture gives about the polygon drawn.
- Swatches: click = foreground, Ctrl+click = background, + keeps a colour (still there after the page is opened
  again), right-click removes a kept one and leaves the built-in ones; keys work after a swatch click.
- Drops: on the start screen (in and outside the box), on an open picture (a layer in the middle at its own
  size), a bigger picture made to fit, refused while a box is open, a text file refused with a message: every
  dragover and drop cancelled. The start screen's New... box (Esc, and 300 x 200 transparent).
- Type: the words keep their size and colour when the bar was changed before clicking them; size and colour
  changed while editing are taken; words moved with the Move tool open again.
- Free Transform: W/H/Angle start at 100/100/0 each time; W 50 halves the layer; choosing another tool applies;
  Esc leaves the layer exactly; type stays type (or says so).
- Straighten by the Ruler line: level within 2 px, no see-through pixel, 564 x 352 as computed; keeping the
  corners: level, 672 x 454. Crop 1:1 dragged in each of the four directions keeps its corner. Quick Mask with
  nothing selected starts all-selected and black paint takes away. History Brush after 53 steps paints the
  picture as opened; from a clicked circle it paints that step; History keeps Open + 50; a greyed step clicked
  goes forward to it; Undo keeps the chosen layer.
- Mends of the first review that hold: Shift+Alt before a marquee drag intersects; Quick Selection's first
  stroke starts anew; a mask from the selection drops the selection; the Pencil is hard-edged; History names as
  the menus (Unsharp Mask, Dust & Scratches, Motion Blur, Brightness/Contrast); the Histogram heading.
- Phone 390 x 844: no sideways scrolling; every menu and every submenu with its shortcut column inside the
  screen; Shadows/Highlights and Layer Style boxes fit; every button within the width (but see 8).
- 12-megapixel photo (4000 x 3000), over the runs: opens in 0.5-0.6 s; Ctrl+G 0.3 s; moving into a group 0.4 s;
  Merge Group 0.4 s; Magnetic Lasso first click 0.6-0.75 s, 0.08-0.10 s a move, Enter 0.7-0.9 s, selection within
  4 px of the red block; Shadows/Highlights preview 1.6-2.7 s, OK 1.4-1.9 s.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WHAT I COULD NOT TEST
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- A real drag of a file from the desktop, and what the browser does with an uncancelled one (only that the page
  cancels the events).
- The keys a browser keeps (Ctrl+T, Ctrl+N, Ctrl+Shift+N) in a real Chrome window, and a Mac's Cmd/Option.
- The Magnetic Lasso on a touch screen: it follows the pointer moving with no button held, which a finger cannot
  do (taps fix points); not tried with real touch.
- Scroll bars: Playwright's headless Chromium hides them, so whether the 1366 x 768 tool column shows one is
  not known; the numbers in finding 8 are measured.
- How the effects and pictures look to a person (Adam's to judge); only numbers were compared.
- Opening the tile's .psd in Photoshop, GIMP or Krita (only psd-tools and the tile itself read it back).
- Crop with a turn and Perspective Crop with a group in the picture (finding 2 is from the code for those two).
- Photoshop itself was not run: its behaviour is cited from Adobe's pages where so marked, else from memory.

Runs: full run 1 (before the last checks were added) 230 checks, 32 failed; full runs 2, 3 and 4 on the frozen
build: 289 checks, 48 failed each time, the same checks failing; about 4.5 minutes a run.
